newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Golf-Leading Doral Open first round scores.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Leading Doral Open first round scores.

text.p: Leading scores from the $1.8 million Doral-Ryder Open at Doral Resort & Spa (Blue course, 6,939 yards, par 72) after the first round on Thursday (players U.S. unless stated):

67 Sandy Lyle (Britain), Stewart Cink, Jay Haas, Doug Martin, Ronnie Black
68 David Duval, Nick Price (Zimbabwe), Marco Dawson, Tommy Tolles, Billy Andrade
69 Raymond Floyd, Larry Rinker, Bruce Lietzke, Kelly Gibson, Brad Sutterfield, Colin Montgomerie (Britain), Paul Goydos, Brad Bryant, Phil Mickelson, David Berganio
70 Fulton Allem (South Africa), Craig Parry (Australia), Steve Elkington (Australia), Naomichi "Joe" Ozaki (Japan)
72 David Frost (South Africa), Grant Waite (New Zealand), Vijay Singh (Fiji), Jesper Parnevik (Sweden)
